name: COLDSPOT
tagline: A carrier-side reserving agent that finds the one coverage fact the lamp cannot warm.

semantic._usage: DATA-ONLY verdict colors. NEVER wire these into generic status chrome (toasts, alerts, badges). Ice = a required fact is missing; jade = reserve/verified; garnet = deny/mismatch.

signatureElement: The COLD-SPOT SWEEP: a fact-lattice scanned by an amber beam, one frost-cold cell the beam cannot warm, and a decision gate that refuses to latch while any cell is cold.

signatureObject.name: cold-spot sweep
signatureObject.thesis: The product's whole job is to surface the one required coverage fact that is missing from a fragmented data field. The signature renders that literally: evidence warms amber where governed sources land a fact, and the single fact the lamp cannot warm stays a frost-ringed cold cell, named, while the decision gate visibly refuses to latch. The absence is the hero, not the verdict.

perSurface.landing: Full SweepEngine on the committed abstain run under a breathing amber lamp radial and masked survey-ruling ground; the full-bleed closer beam snags on the cold cell.
perSurface.console: Zero ambient atmosphere; the sweep compresses to a per-row MiniLattice (8 facts, hollow ink = not-yet-investigated, dashed ice = cold) so felt completeness reads at a glance across a dense queue.

invariantPhrase: The one fact the lamp cannot warm.

statusLegend.meaning: a governed source landed this required fact, or the agent is sweeping
a required fact is missing; the gate is held open and the fact is named
all facts resolved, gate latched, reserve issued
a governed source contradicts coverage; gate latched deny
not yet investigated: hollow hairline cells (no fill), never ice
